name: Letter to Ello
summary: Abercrombie sends a sealed letter to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke in Darkshire. The hermit lives in a shack just north of Raven Hill Cemetery, claims an old friendship, and writes the missive in an archaic script.

sections.title: A Bizarre Greeting
sections.body: After you help Abercrombie with tasks around Duskwood, the old recluse gives you a note for Mayor Ello Ebonlocke. He says the mayor is an old friend who will celebrate what you have accomplished. When Ello breaks the seal, he has no recollection of anyone named Abercrombie and cannot read a single phrase of the archaic script. He sends the note to Darkshire scholar Sirra Von'Indi for translation.

sections.title: Dark Omens
sections.body: Abercrombie's runes carry a grim meaning for Darkshire. The letter does not describe an old friendship between town acquaintances; it spells doom for the whole town.

faq.q: Who wrote the Letter to Ello?
faq.answer: Abercrombie wrote the letter. He is a hermit living in a ramshackle hut near Raven Hill Cemetery in western Duskwood.

faq.q: Can Mayor Ello Ebonlocke read the letter?
aliases: why cant ello read the note
faq.answer: No. When Ello Ebonlocke breaks the seal, the script is completely incomprehensible to him and appears to be written in an ancient, unrecognizable language.
Sirra Von'Indi can translate the note. Mayor Ebonlocke sends it to the resident scholar in Darkshire, who knows ancient scripts and esoteric languages.

faq.q: Does Mayor Ebonlocke actually know Abercrombie?
faq.answer: No. Though Abercrombie claims they are old friends, Ello Ebonlocke says he has never heard of anyone named Abercrombie.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler in Duskwood, you may carry a dispatch from an eccentric recluse to a town mayor. Darkshire's officials remain on edge around strange missives.
